title: Body Fat Calculator: how it works, formula and examples
excerpt: Body Fat Calculator: Body fat percentage using the US Navy method. Learn how to use it, the formula behind it, a worked example and answers to common questions.
content:
The [Body Fat Calculator](/body-fat-calculator) is a free online tool on CalcHub. Body fat percentage using the US Navy method. Enter your sex, height, waist, neck, hip (women only) and weight and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. Because it runs entirely in your browser, the values you type never leave your device, and you can use it as often as you like.

The US Navy method estimates body fat from simple tape measurements. It's more informative than BMI because it reflects body composition. This guide explains how to use it, the formula it applies, and a worked example you can follow with your own numbers. Related Health & Fitness tools include [BMI Calculator](/bmi-calculator), [Calorie Calculator](/calorie-calculator) and [BMR Calculator](/bmr-calculator). People also look for this tool as "body fat percentage calculator", "navy body fat calculator", "lean body mass calculator".

## How to use the Body Fat Calculator

Start by choosing your sex from the list, then entering your height (cm), entering your waist (cm), entering your neck (cm), entering your hip (women only) (cm) and finally entering your weight (kg). The result updates as you type, so adjust any value and watch the answer change. If the answer is not what you expected, check the value you entered first — a missing digit or a wrong unit is the usual cause. When you want a clean slate, Reset restores the defaults.

1. Choose your sex from the list.
2. Enter your height (cm).
3. Enter your waist (cm).
4. Enter your neck (cm).
5. Enter your hip (women only) (cm).
6. Enter your weight (kg).

## Formula

Men: 495 ÷ (1.0324 − 0.19077·log(waist − neck) + 0.15456·log(height)) − 450. Women add hip to waist with different constants.

That is the standard formula for this calculation, and it is the same one the [Body Fat Calculator](/body-fat-calculator) applies to the values you enter. You can work it out by hand, but the calculator is faster when you want to try several values, and it removes the risk of a slip in the arithmetic. If the figures look wrong, check your inputs first — a misplaced decimal point is the usual culprit.

## Worked example

Here is a typical example. A man 178 cm tall with an 85 cm waist and 38 cm neck has roughly 17% body fat. Try the same figures in the [Body Fat Calculator](/body-fat-calculator) and you will get the same result — then change one value at a time to see how the answer moves. The steps are the same whatever numbers you use; only the figures change.

## What the result shows

With the default values (Sex: Male, Height: 178 cm, Waist: 85 cm, Neck: 38 cm, Hip (women only): 95 cm, Weight: 75 kg), the [Body Fat Calculator](/body-fat-calculator) returns Body fat: 16.4%, Fat mass: 12.3 kg, Lean mass: 62.7 kg. The first figure is the headline result, and the rest break it down so you can see how the total is made up. Change any value and every figure updates instantly. If you want to compare with a related calculation, the [BMI Calculator](/bmi-calculator) is worth a look before you finish.

## Tips

A few things worth knowing before you rely on the result — most of them are about the numbers you put in, rather than the tool itself:

- Measure the waist at the navel, relaxed.
- Measure at the same time of day for consistency.

Keep these in mind and the figures will be as useful as the numbers you put in.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is a healthy body fat percentage?

Roughly 10–20% for men and 18–28% for women, varying with age. Try it with your own numbers in the [Body Fat Calculator](/body-fat-calculator) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### How accurate is the Navy method?

Typically within 3–4% of DEXA scans for most people. For figures that matter, such as money, health or legal deadlines, check the result against an authoritative source before acting on it.

### What formula does the Body Fat Calculator use?

Men: 495 ÷ (1.0324 − 0.19077·log(waist − neck) + 0.15456·log(height)) − 450. Women add hip to waist with different constants. You can see it in action in the [Body Fat Calculator](/body-fat-calculator) — enter your own values and the result updates as you type.

### What do I need to use the Body Fat Calculator?

Just Sex, Height, Waist, Neck, Hip (women only) and Weight. Enter those values and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. If you are unsure about a value, try a rough figure first and then refine it — the result updates instantly.

Yes. The Body Fat Calculator is free to use as often as you like, with no sign-up. There is no limit on how often you use it, nothing to install, and no account to create — open the [Body Fat Calculator](/body-fat-calculator) and start straight away.
